items.title: Minicucci Sets UD Records for Consecutive Completions and Consecutive Completions to Start Game as Football Defeats WKU, 35-21
items.summary: BOWLING GREEN, Ky. – QB Nick Minicucci set the program record for consecutive completions and consecutive completions to begin a game (18) as the University of Delaware football team downed Western Kentucky, 35-21, on Tuesday night at Houchens-Smith Stadium. The Fightin' Blue Hens have now won two-straight games, improving to 4-4, 2-2 CUSA, while the Hilltoppers drop to 3-5, 2-2 CUSA.

items.title: Football Takes Home Three Weekly CUSA Awards
items.summary: DALLAS – University of Delaware football took home three Conference USA weekly awards for its efforts against Missouri State, the league announced Monday. QB Nick Minicucci earned CUSA's Offensive Player of the Week award, LB Jawarren Corbin was named the league's defensive player of the week, and OL Steven Demboski won the CUSA Offensive Lineman of the Week award. items.title: Football’s Minicucci Named to Davey O’Brien Great 8 for Week 8, Earns Spot on Midseason Watchlist
items.summary: FORT WORTH, Texas – University of Delaware football QB Nick Minicucci has been named to the Davey O'Brien Great 8 for Week 8, the Davey O'Brien Foundation announced Monday. By making the Great 8, Minicucci qualified for the Davey O'Brien Award Midseason Watchlist. items.title: Football Wraps Weekday CUSA Play at WKU
items.summary: NEWARK, Del. – The University of Delaware football team will head to Bowling Green, Ky. to face the WKU Hilltoppers on Tuesday, October 27 at 7 p.m. for a Weekday CUSA matchup on CBS Sports Network. This will be the fourth matchup all-time between the two programs as the Fightin' Blue Hens hold a 2-1 record against the Hilltoppers. items.title: Football’s Demboski Named One of 20 Semifinalists for 2026 Jason Witten Collegiate Man of the Year
items.summary: DALLAS – University of Delaware football OL Steven Demboski has been named to a 2026 Jason Witten Collegiate Man of the Year Semifinalist, the Jason Witten Collegiate Man of the Year Selection Committee announced Tuesday. items.title: Minicucci Ties Delaware Single-Game Passing Touchdowns Record as Football Dominates Missouri State, 61-38
items.summary: NEWARK, Del. – QB Nick Minicucci tied the program single-game record for passing touchdowns with five as the University of Delaware football team dominated Missouri State, 61-38, on Tuesday night at Delaware Stadium. The Fightin' Blue Hens rise to 3-4, 1-2 CUSA, while the Bears drop to 2-5, 1-2 CUSA.

items.title: Football's Bell Named CUSA Freshman of the Week
items.summary: DALLAS – University of Delaware football QB Tyler Bell has been named Conference USA's Freshman of the Week for his performance against Middle Tennessee, the league announced Monday. He is the second Fightin' Blue Hen to earn this honor this season, joining S Kevin Moore after his performance against Merrimack.

items.title: Football Plays Host to Missouri State on Tuesday for Senior Day
items.summary: NEWARK, Del. – The University of Delaware football team will host the Missouri State Bears on Tuesday, October 20 at 7 p.m. for a Weekday CUSA matchup on ESPNU. This will be the first matchup between the two programs that moved to the FBS and joined Conference USA together in 2025.

items.title: Football’s Demboski Named to 2026 Lombardi Award Midseason Watchlist
items.summary: HOUSTON – University of Delaware football OL Steven Demboski has been named to the 2026 Lombardi Award Midseason Watchlist, the Rotary Club of Houston and Lombardi Award Committee announced Wednesday. Demboski became the first player in program history to make the Lombardi Award Watchlist when he was named to the preseason list.

items.title: Bell Sets Freshman Single-Game Passing Record in First-Career Start as Football Falls at Middle Tennessee
items.summary: MURFREESBORO, Tenn. – QB Tyler Bell set the Delaware single-game passing yards record by a freshman (306) as the University of Delaware football team lost a close one to the Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders, 33-30, on Tuesday night at Johnny "Red" Floyd Stadium. The Fightin' Blue Hens drop to 2-4, 0-2 CUSA, while the Blue Raiders rise to 3-3, 1-1 CUSA.
